gloss: to make a profit; to gain a benefit

definitions.gloss: to make a profit; to earn a return
definitions.explanation: To come out financially ahead from a business, sale, or investment.

definitions.gloss: to gain a benefit; to profit from something
definitions.explanation: To obtain an advantage that need not be monetary — a favorable position, useful information, or an improved situation. Often used when pointing out who stands to gain from an arrangement.

notes:
A set phrase pairing ⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧ (profit, benefit) with ⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧ (to obtain). ⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧ is a written-style verb, so the phrase belongs to news reporting, business writing, and formal speech; in conversation people say {儲|もう}かる or ⟦{得|とく}をする→得をする：30190_tokuwosuru⟧ instead.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ...⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{利益|りえき}を{得|え}る: to profit from ...
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{利益|りえき}を{得|え}る: to make a large profit
- ⟦{不当|ふとう}→不当：11319_futou⟧な{利益|りえき}を{得|え}る: to obtain an improper gain

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to raise profits — focuses on the company's own performance
- {儲|もう}かる: to be profitable — casual and intransitive; the money-maker is the subject
- ⟦{得|とく}をする→得をする：30190_tokuwosuru⟧: to come out ahead — casual, everyday advantage rather than accounted profit
